entries.name: Ant System proportional transition
entries.notes: Generic pheromone/heuristic categorical transition; sampled by the equivalent log-space Gumbel-max identity.

entries.name: Classical all-ant global pheromone update
entries.notes: O(1) lazy global evaporation followed by reinforcement from every completed ant.

entries.name: Constant domain-neutral deposit
entries.notes: Representation-independent non-negative deposit for objective scales where Q/L is not meaningful.

entries.name: Positive-minimization Q/L deposit
entries.notes: Explicitly restricted to finite strictly-positive minimization objectives.

entries.name: Ant Colony System
entries.notes: Requires ACS pseudo-random proportional choice, local pheromone update and distinct global-update semantics.

entries.name: MAX-MIN Ant System
entries.notes: Requires bounded pheromone trails and selective best-solution reinforcement; reserved for the advanced ACO layer.
